import io
import json
from decimal import localcontext
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

from totals import totals


class ValidationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_large_amounts_are_exact_even_with_low_decimal_precision(self):
        data = ('category,amount\n'
                'a,123456789012345678901234567890.12\n'
                'a,0.01\n'
                'b,-123456789012345678901234567890.12\n'
                'b,-0.01\n')
        with localcontext() as context:
            context.prec = 2
            self.assertEqual({
                'a': '123456789012345678901234567890.13',
                'b': '-123456789012345678901234567890.13',
            }, totals(io.StringIO(data)))

    def test_trimming_merges_categories_and_normalizes_zero(self):
        data = 'category,amount\n a ,2.50\na,-2.50\nb,-0.00\n'
        self.assertEqual({'a': '0.00', 'b': '0.00'}, totals(io.StringIO(data)))

    def test_empty_input_and_blank_lines(self):
        for data in ('', '\n\n', 'category,amount\n\n', '\n\ncategory,amount\n'):
            with self.subTest(data=data):
                self.assertEqual({}, totals(io.StringIO(data)))

    def test_reordered_columns_and_quoted_categories(self):
        self.assertEqual({'a,b': '1.20'}, totals(io.StringIO(
            'amount,category\n 1.20 ," a,b "\n')))
        self.assertEqual({'a': '1.00'}, totals(io.StringIO(
            '\n\ncategory,amount\na,1\n')))

    def test_numeric_input_forms(self):
        self.assertEqual({'a': '122.00'}, totals(io.StringIO(
            'category,amount\na,+1\na,.50\na,-.5\na,1.\na,1.2e2\n')))

    def test_invalid_amounts(self):
        for amount in ('', ' ', 'nan', 'sNaN', '+inf', '-inf', 'Infinity',
                       '1.001', '1.000', '0.000', '1e-3', '1_00', '0x10',
                       '1 2', '--1', '1e', 'hello'):
            with self.subTest(amount=amount), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                totals(io.StringIO(f'category,amount\na,{amount}\n'))

    def test_invalid_schema_and_rows(self):
        invalid = (
            'category\n', 'amount\n', 'category,amount,extra\n',
            'category,category\na,b\n', 'category,amount,amount\n',
            'Category,amount\n', 'category,amount\na\n',
            'category,amount\na,1,\n', 'category,amount\n  ,1\n',
            'category,amount\n"a,1\n',
        )
        for data in invalid:
            with self.subTest(data=data), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                totals(io.StringIO(data))

    def run_cli(self, data):
        return subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, '-B', str(Path(__file__).with_name('cli.py'))],
            input=data, text=True, capture_output=True,
        )

    def test_cli_rejects_each_invalid_input_atomically(self):
        invalid = [f'category,amount\na,1\nb,{amount}\n'
                   for amount in ('no', 'NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity', '1.001', '')]
        invalid += ['category,amount\na,1\n ,2\n',
                    'category,amount\na,1\nb,2,extra\n',
                    'category,amount\na,1\nb\n',
                    'category\na\n', 'category,amount,extra\n',
                    'category,amount\na,1\n"unfinished\n']
        for data in invalid:
            with self.subTest(data=data):
                run = self.run_cli(data)
                self.assertEqual(2, run.returncode)
                self.assertEqual('', run.stdout)
                self.assertTrue(run.stderr.strip())
                self.assertEqual(1, len(run.stderr.splitlines()))
                self.assertLess(len(run.stderr), 100)
                self.assertNotIn('Traceback', run.stderr)

    def test_cli_empty_and_sorted_fixed_precision_json(self):
        for data, expected in (
            ('', {}), ('\n\n', {}), ('category,amount\n', {}),
            ('\n\ncategory,amount\n', {}),
            ('category,amount\nz,-2.50\n a ,0.1\na,0.2\n',
             {'a': '0.30', 'z': '-2.50'}),
        ):
            with self.subTest(data=data):
                run = self.run_cli(data)
                self.assertEqual(0, run.returncode)
                self.assertEqual('', run.stderr)
                self.assertEqual(expected, json.loads(run.stdout))
                self.assertEqual(sorted(expected), list(json.loads(run.stdout)))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import io
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

from totals import totals


class TotalsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_decimal(self):
        self.assertEqual({'a': '0.30'}, totals(io.StringIO('category,amount\na,0.1\na,0.2\n')))

    def test_order_whitespace_and_negative(self):
        self.assertEqual({'a': '1.00', 'b': '-2.50'}, totals(io.StringIO('category,amount\n b ,-2.50\n a ,1\n')))

    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual({}, totals(io.StringIO('category,amount\n')))

    def test_invalid_rows(self):
        for record in ('a,no', 'a,NaN', 'a,Infinity', 'a,-Infinity', ',1', 'a,0.001', 'a,1,extra'):
            with self.subTest(record=record), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                totals(io.StringIO('category,amount\n' + record + '\n'))

    def test_missing_columns(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            totals(io.StringIO('category\na\n'))

    def test_cli_success(self):
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', 'cli.py'], input='category,amount\nb,2\na,1\n', text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(0, run.returncode)
        self.assertEqual('', run.stderr)
        self.assertEqual({'a': '1.00', 'b': '2.00'}, json.loads(run.stdout))
        self.assertLess(run.stdout.index('"a"'), run.stdout.index('"b"'))

    def test_cli_failure_is_atomic(self):
        run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', 'cli.py'], input='category,amount\na,1\nb,NaN\n', text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(2, run.returncode)
        self.assertEqual('', run.stdout)
        self.assertTrue(run.stderr.strip())
        self.assertNotIn('Traceback', run.stderr)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import json
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

import ranges
import tags


class Contract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_tags(self):
        values = [' B ', 'a', 'b', '', ' Straße ', 'STRASSE']
        before = values[:]
        self.assertEqual(['b', 'a', 'strasse'], tags.normalize(values))
        self.assertEqual(before, values)
        self.assertEqual([], tags.normalize([]))

    def test_tag_types(self):
        for values in ('abc', [1], [None], [True]):
            with self.subTest(values=values), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                tags.normalize(values)

    def test_merge(self):
        values = [(7, 9), (1, 4), (3, 6), (9, 10), (20, 20)]
        before = values[:]
        self.assertEqual([(1, 6), (7, 10), (20, 20)], ranges.merge(values))
        self.assertEqual(before, values)
        self.assertEqual([], ranges.merge([]))

    def test_range_validation(self):
        for value in ([(2, 1)], [(1,)], [(1, 2, 3)], [('1', 2)], [(True, 2)], [(1.0, 2)], '12'):
            with self.subTest(value=value), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                ranges.merge(value)

    def test_batch(self):
        rows = json.loads(Path('batch.json').read_text())
        self.assertEqual([1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8], [x['id'] for x in rows])
        self.assertEqual(['ready','ready','ready','archived','ready','ready','ready','archived'], [x['status'] for x in rows])
        self.assertEqual('draft remains in note', rows[0]['note'])
        self.assertEqual(['Alpha','Beta','Gamma','Delta','Epsilon','Zeta','Eta','Theta'], [x['label'] for x in rows])

    def test_integration(self):
        self.assertEqual({'tags':['a'], 'ranges':[[1,4]]}, json.loads(json.dumps({'tags': tags.normalize([' A ','a']), 'ranges': ranges.merge([(1,2),(2,4)])})))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
